entries.note: False friend: 丈夫 is a husband (chồng); Vietnamese trượng phu means a man of noble character.
False friend: 东西 (dōng xi) means a thing, stuff (đồ); only 东西 with full tones is east and west.
False friend: 中间 is the middle, in between (ở giữa); Vietnamese trung gian means an intermediary.
主: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list chủ (it lists Nôm or other readings); chủ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
主: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list chủ (it lists Nôm or other readings); chủ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
Partly a false friend: 习惯 is a personal habit (thói quen); Vietnamese tập quán is a custom of a community.

仓: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 仓 or 倉; thương is its standard Hán-Việt reading. 库: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list khố (it lists the everyday kho); khố is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
Partly a false friend: at school 作业 is homework (bài tập); in a factory 作业 is a work operation, as Vietnamese tác nghiệp (作业区 khu tác nghiệp).
Vietnamese says khang kiện or khoẻ mạnh: the same two characters in the other order.
False friend: 入口 on a sign is the entrance (lối vào); Vietnamese nhập khẩu means import.
Partly a false friend: on a sign 出口 is the exit (lối ra); about goods it is export (xuất khẩu), as in Vietnamese. Import is 进口, not 入口.
办: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 办 or 辦; biện is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
努: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 努; nỗ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
医生 is a doctor (bác sĩ); Vietnamese y sinh is an old word for a physician or a medical student.
Partly a false friend: 可能 is also "maybe" (có lẽ); Vietnamese khả năng is ability or possibility.
False friend: 名字 is a person's name (tên); Vietnamese danh từ / danh tự is a grammar word, a noun.
Partly a false friend: 商场 is a shopping mall; Vietnamese thương trường is the market in the figurative sense (the business world).
Partly a false friend: 商量 is to talk something over (bàn bạc); Vietnamese thương lượng is to negotiate.
址: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list chỉ (it lists Nôm or other readings); chỉ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
False friend: 地方 (dì fang) is a place, a spot (chỗ, nơi); Vietnamese địa phương means a locality or region.
夏: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 夏; hạ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
女: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list nữ (it lists Nôm or other readings); nữ is its standard Hán-Việt reading.

False friend: 妻子 (qī zi) is one's wife (vợ); Vietnamese thê tử means wife and children.

静: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 静 or 靜; tĩnh is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
False friend: 家人 are one's family members; Vietnamese gia nhân means household servants.
False friend: 容易 means easy (dễ); Vietnamese dung dị means simple, unpretentious.
码: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 码 or 碼; mã is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
面: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 面; diện is its standard Hán-Việt reading.

Partly a false friend: 小姐 is the polite "Miss" with a surname (李小姐); on the Mainland do not call a waitress just 小姐 (say 服务员), the bare word can be misread. Vietnamese tiểu thư suggests a young lady of a well-off family.
False friend: 小心 means careful, look out (cẩn thận); Vietnamese has no tiểu tâm in this sense.
Partly a false friend: 工作 is a job, to work (công việc, làm việc); Vietnamese công tác is an assignment or a business trip.
希: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list hy (it lists Nôm or other readings); hy is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
False friend: 快乐 is happy, joyful (vui vẻ); Vietnamese khoái lạc means (sensual) pleasure.
False friend: 意思 is meaning (ý nghĩa); Vietnamese ý tứ means tact, discretion.
者: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 者; giả is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
False friend: 所以 means so, therefore (cho nên); Vietnamese sở dĩ means "the reason why".
False friend: 提高 means to raise, improve (nâng cao); Vietnamese đề cao means to praise or uphold.
年: Unihan 17.0.0 kVietnamese does not list niên (it lists Nôm or other readings); niên is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
Partly a false friend: 新闻 is the news (tin tức); Vietnamese tân văn is an old word for a newspaper.
False friend: 方便 means convenient (thuận tiện); Vietnamese phương tiện means a means or a vehicle.
游: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 游 or 遊; du is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
时: kVietnamese of 時 (traditional of 时) lists only thì; thời is the reading in 时间 (thời gian).
春: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 春; xuân is its standard Hán-Việt reading.

False friend: 水平 is a level of skill (trình độ); Vietnamese thuỷ bình is a spirit level.
汽: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 汽; khí is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
False friend: 照顾 means to look after (chăm sóc); Vietnamese chiếu cố means to show favour.
Partly a false friend: in Mainland Chinese 爱人 is one's husband or wife; Vietnamese ái nhân is a lover.

False friend: 认真 means conscientious, serious (nghiêm túc, chăm chỉ); Vietnamese nhận chân means to see the truth.

False friend: 认识 means to know a person, to be acquainted (quen biết); Vietnamese nhận thức means awareness or cognition. 识: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 识 or 識; thức is the standard Hán-Việt reading.

Partly a false friend: 身体 is also one's health (你身体好吗 = bạn có khoẻ không); Vietnamese thân thể is only the body.
Partly a false friend: 辞职 is leaving any job (nghỉ việc); Vietnamese từ chức means resigning from an office or post.
问, 题: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for either (nor for 問, 題); vấn đề is the standard Hán-Việt reading.

Partly a false friend: 非常 is just "very" (rất); Vietnamese phi thường means extraordinary.
乐: kVietnamese of 樂 (traditional of 乐) lists only lạc; nhạc (music) is the reading in 音乐.
False friend: 颜色 is a colour (màu sắc); Vietnamese nhan sắc means a woman's beauty.
食: Unihan 17.0.0 has no kVietnamese for 食; thực is its standard Hán-Việt reading.
